vocabulary.example: I recently started a new job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not modern; from an older style

vocabulary.example: My phone is outdated; some apps don't work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not used by anyone any more
vocabulary.example: Nobody uses a slide rule now; that technology is obsolete.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in the present time, which is different from the past
vocabulary.meaning_ar: في هذه الأيام / في الوقت الحاضر
vocabulary.note_en: A period of time, not one moment.
vocabulary.example: Nowadays, most people pay by card.

vocabulary.meaning_en: recently; in the last few days or weeks
vocabulary.note_ar: يكثر مع المضارع التام: I haven't seen him lately
vocabulary.note_en: Often with present perfect: I haven't seen him lately.

vocabulary.example: Have you heard the latest news?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the day after the day you are talking about
vocabulary.example: We arrived on Monday and visited the museum the next day.
Today is Friday; a week from now is next Friday.
Today is Monday, so the day after tomorrow is Wednesday.
The party is the week after next.
My exam is two weeks from now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the Wednesday of this week, which has not come yet
vocabulary.example: It's Monday. I'll see you this Wednesday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: usually: the Wednesday of the following week
vocabulary.note_ar: قد يسبّب لبسًا حتى عند المتحدثين الأصليين، فاسأل للتأكد
vocabulary.note_en: Can be confusing even for native speakers; check the date.
vocabulary.example: The meeting isn't this Wednesday; it's next Wednesday.
I haven't seen him of late.

vocabulary.meaning_en: now, in contrast to the past
vocabulary.example: These days it's easy to call people anywhere.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do something that causes problems or confusion
vocabulary.note_ar: في بريطانيا: throw a spanner in the works
vocabulary.note_en: UK: throw a spanner in the works.
vocabulary.example: The rain threw a monkey wrench into our picnic plans.

fine_lines.title: old-fashioned vs outdated vs obsolete
fine_lines.explanation_ar: old-fashioned: من طراز قديم وليس عصريًا. outdated: قديم ولم يعد مفيدًا كالجديد. obsolete: لم يعد أحد يستخدمه أبدًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Old-fashioned: from an older style. Outdated: old and not as useful as new things. Obsolete: nobody uses it any more.

fine_lines.title: nowadays vs lately vs latest
fine_lines.explanation_ar: nowadays: الحاضر مقارنة بالماضي (فترة طويلة، سنوات). lately: مؤخرًا (أيام أو أسابيع). latest: صفة بمعنى الأحدث.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Nowadays: the present compared with the past (a long period). Lately: recently (days or weeks). Latest: adjective = the newest.

fine_lines.title: this Wednesday vs next Wednesday
fine_lines.explanation_ar: this Wednesday: الأربعاء في هذا الأسبوع ولم يأتِ بعد. next Wednesday: غالبًا الأربعاء في الأسبوع التالي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: This Wednesday: the Wednesday of this week (not yet here). Next Wednesday: usually the Wednesday of the following week.

examples.sentence: Today is Monday. The test is this Wednesday, in two days.
The trip is next Wednesday, in nine days.

expressions.phrase: Have you heard the latest news?
expressions.meaning_en: Do you know the newest news?
expressions.example: Have you heard the latest news? The road is closed.
Hi! I haven't seen you lately. Where have you been?
In the old days, phones were on the kitchen wall.

grammar.title: Counting forward: the day after tomorrow, the week after next
grammar.explanation_ar: اليوم = 1، غدًا = 2، بعد غد = 3، أي the day after tomorrow بعد يومين من اليوم. وبالطريقة نفسها: هذا الأسبوع، الأسبوع القادم (next week)، ثم the week after next = بعد أسبوعين.
grammar.explanation_en: Today, tomorrow, then the day after tomorrow = two days from now. This week, next week, then the week after next = two weeks from now.
examples: Today is Monday; the day after tomorrow is Wednesday.
It's the 1st; the week after next starts on the 15th.
We'll finish two weeks from now.

questions.question: "Nobody uses a slide rule any more. That technology is ___."
"___, kids spend a lot of time on phones." (present vs past)
questions.explanation_en: Nowadays = these days, unlike the past.

questions.question: Today is Monday. "The day after tomorrow" is ___.
questions.explanation_en: Two days from Monday is Wednesday.

questions.question: My phone works, but it's old and can't use new apps. It's ___.
questions.explanation_ar: outdated = قديم لم يعد مفيدًا كالجديد.
questions.explanation_en: Outdated = not as useful as new ones.
